preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be an integer.
The output must be a non-negative integer less than 998244353.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len(set(tuple(P[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(P)) for j in range(i, len(P)))) % 998244353
postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct subarrays of the concatenated permutation sequence P, modulo 998244353.
